messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning to deploy inference-service v3.4.0 to prod tomorrow 2026-03-18 22:00 UTC. CI + canary passed in staging. I need: smoke owners, rollback criteria confirmed, and a final go/no-go owner. @Priya @Ben can you own smoke and rollback respectively?

Priya: Ack, I can own smoke. Will run core flows + latency checks. Quick list I’ll validate: login, inference basic path, batch job kickoff, embedding consistency. Will post results in this thread.

Ben: I can own rollback. Quick notes on rollback plan: primary rollback is feature-flag toggle for new-serving + infra rollback to last stable tag if needed. Rollback criteria I suggest:
- sustained 5xx > 1% for 5m OR
- request error spikes affecting critical paths (login or inference) OR
- p95 latency > 800ms for 5m OR
- regression in quality checks (embedding drift > threshold)

Marie: Can we add an automatic fallback if canary error rate > 0.5% within first 10min? i.e., stop rollout and auto-fallback to canary baseline.

Ben: Yes — we have the orchestrator rule to stop canary. I’ll confirm the alerts are wired to ops-runbook.

Alex: Notes on timeline + roles:
- 21:45 UTC: final preflight (Alex) — confirm infra ready and infra-metrics green
- 22:00 UTC: start canary (10% traffic) — Priya smoke starts immediately
- 22:10 UTC: canary evaluation (10m window) — automatic checks + Priya manual smoke
- 22:20 UTC: full rollout if go/no-go = GO (Alex owns final signal)
- 22:40 UTC: fallback window ends. If problems, Ben triggers rollback

Priya: Smoke run commands I’ll use today for rehearsals:
```bash
./scripts/smoke/run_smoke.sh --env prod --checks login,inference,latency --output /tmp/smoke-prod.json
cat /tmp/smoke-prod.json | jq '.summary'
```
I’ll post results 30m before deploy.

Tom: Release manager approved the window earlier; adding an automated note: @release-bot can you attach the release ticket and link?

release-bot: Attached release ticket: https://rwinf.example.com/releases/INF-3421. Approval: Release Manager (Tom) — window OK.

Marie: Minor config check — make sure model-weights path is pinned (we had a mismatch last time). Who can confirm artifact tag is v3.4.0 and not latest?

Alex: Confirmed: artifact tag pinned to v3.4.0 in deployment manifest. Hash: 9a7b3c. I’ll paste the deploy commands here for quick rollback reference.

Alex: Deploy / rollback snips:
```bash
# start canary
kubectl apply -f k8s/deployments/inference-canary-v3.4.0.yaml
# toggle feature-flag off (rollback path)
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' https://flags.example.com/api/toggles/new-serving/off
# infra rollback (if needed)
terraform apply -var='image_tag=v3.3.9' -target=module.inference_service
```

Ben: I’ll make sure the infra playbook has those exact commands (and will be on standby). Also: if we hit the p95 latency threshold, we rollback immediately — no manual wait.

Priya: Quick question — who verifies quality regression checks? I can run the smoke evals, but want to confirm the eval harness owner for embeddings.

Marie: I own the eval harness. I’ll run embeddings drift and sanity prompts during the canary window and post a pass/fail.

Tom: I’ll be on call for release coordination. Alex will call GO if all checks green at 22:10. If anyone sees a problem before that, post here and we stop rollout.

Alex: Final ask: everyone reply with short ack and which specific check you’ll watch. I’ll collect and call GO at 22:10 if all green.

Priya: Ack — watching: login success, inference basic, p95 latency.

Ben: Ack — watching infra errors, alert hooks, rollback commands ready.

Marie: Ack — watching embedding drift + eval harness.

Tom: Ack — coordinating release ticket and comms.

Alex: Great — thanks all. I’ll post a 30m reminder. :thumbsup:
